{"reason": "v1's 34 supplier-switches cost 45000 each and caused all 4 stockouts (late alt-supplier rows like inventory-days=5.3 and 2.8, 195000 each). alert-planner costs 35000 (<45000) and always arrives in time, so repointing the medium/high branch to alert-planner cuts cost to ~1.225M and removes all late-arrival stockouts.", "source": "(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'high)) (< inventory-days 5))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
